fileheader.author: Community A350 project
fileheader.description: Educational, provisional JSBSim model of an A350-900 class transport.
fileheader.note: This is an independently authored, non-certified simulation approximation. Only public airframe dimensions and headline mass/thrust figures inform the model. Aerodynamic derivatives, inertias, systems logic and handling are engineering estimates, not Airbus data and not suitable for real-world use.
